mentions.title: King Bearings
mentions.snippet: BMW M3 forum thread surfaced on a complaint/defect query. Search snippet describes King STDX undersize sets for the S65/S85 whose thrust bearings were reported over 1mm too narrow to fit the block on more than one example, with posters advising against King for those applications. NEW - not previously in the ledger.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread claiming King main thrust bearings produced since 2024 are out of spec on free spread, with the poster saying King's own tech line confirmed it and advised returning them. Also reports the thrust bearing slipping into the cap and block groove with no interference fit, raising a spin risk.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully again: still no King or official reply, thread open and unresolved, most recent post still 3 June 2026.
